eyebrow.zh: 记录处理 · 来源证据

headline.zh:
时间线里的事件，
回到原文核对。
headline.en:
Review the timeline.
Return to the source.

sub.zh: ClinRec 将本地记录经过文本去重、实体抽取和编码关联整理成时间线，并保留原文位置及各处理步骤的哈希记录。
sub.en: ClinRec organizes local records into timelines through text deduplication, entity extraction and coding, retaining evidence spans and hashes for processing steps.

caption.zh: 把记录整理成能回查来源的时间线
caption.en: Organize records into a source-linked timeline.

body.zh: 按规范化文本哈希识别相同内容，保留来源文件信息。
body.en: Normalized-text hashes identify equivalent content while retaining source information.

body.zh: 时间线事件可回到对应原文 span，便于人工复核。
body.en: Timeline events retain source spans for human review.

body.zh: 哈希与模型/规则标识记录每步处理所用路径。
body.en: Hashes and model/rule identifiers record the route used by each operation.

title.zh: 把记录整理成能回查来源的时间线
title.en: Organize records into a source-linked timeline.

body.zh: 同一记录可能重复出现，不同日期的事件又分散在多份文件中。先消除相同文本的重复，再把事件与证据放在一起，可以减少复核时来回查找文件的负担。软件抽取结果仍需专业复核，不能把一份处理日志当成临床正确性或合规认证。
body.en: Repeated records and events scattered across dated documents make review laborious. Deduplicating equivalent text and keeping events alongside evidence can reduce the search for source material. Extracted results still require professional review; a processing log is not clinical validation or compliance certification.

body.zh: 脚本在临时目录创建三份虚构 TXT，其中一份仅大小写和空白不同。实际保留 2 条记录、跳过 1 条重复，使用规则 linker 得到 3 个事件和 13 条完整哈希链记录。本次运行的 NER 是 regex 回退；安装 medspaCy 后 ner_engine 字段会体现相应路径。
body.en: The script creates three fictional TXT files, one differing only in case and whitespace. The observed run retains two records, skips one duplicate, and produces three events and thirteen intact audit entries with the rule-based linker. This run uses regex NER fallback; an installed medspaCy environment is identified in ner_engine.

body.zh: ingest 按文件类型提取文本，dedup 计算规范化文本哈希。resolve 使用 medspaCy 或 regex 路径抽取实体，Linker 使用配置的 Ollama 或规则回退。TimelineAssembler 合并编码、日期及证据，State 保存 JSON；AuditChain 记录每步输入/输出哈希并链接前一条记录。
body.en: ingest extracts text by file type and dedup hashes normalized text. resolve extracts entities through medspaCy or regex; Linker uses the configured Ollama endpoint or rule fallback. TimelineAssembler combines codes, dates and evidence, State persists JSON, and AuditChain links per-operation input/output hashes.

body.zh: ClinRec 将本地记录经过文本去重、实体抽取和编码关联整理成时间线，并保留原文位置及各处理步骤的哈希记录。
body.en: ClinRec organizes local records into timelines through text deduplication, entity extraction and coding, retaining evidence spans and hashes for processing steps.

body.zh: 输出不是诊断、编码正确性或监管合规的保证，需专业复核。
body.en: Output does not guarantee diagnosis, coding accuracy or regulatory compliance and requires professional review.

note.zh: v0.7.0 的本地构造样例。脚本保留一个不监听的回环端口，令真实 linker 使用已实现的规则回退；没有调用模型。结果不验证真实病历质量、OCR、模型效果或监管要求。
note.en: A constructed local v0.7.0 example. A reserved, non-listening loopback port makes the real linker use its implemented rule fallback; no model is called. Results do not validate clinical records, OCR, model quality or regulatory requirements.

body.zh: 脚本在临时目录创建三份虚构 TXT，其中一份仅大小写和空白不同。实际保留 2 条记录、跳过 1 条重复，使用规则 linker 得到 3 个事件和 13 条完整哈希链记录。本次运行的 NER 是 regex 回退；安装 medspaCy 后 ner_engine 字段会体现相应路径。
body.en: The script creates three fictional TXT files, one differing only in case and whitespace. The observed run retains two records, skips one duplicate, and produces three events and thirteen intact audit entries with the rule-based linker. This run uses regex NER fallback; an installed medspaCy environment is identified in ner_engine.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。完整安装包括 NLP/OCR 客户端依赖；图片 OCR 还需系统 Tesseract。TXT 示例不需要 OCR 或模型权重。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Full installation includes NLP/OCR client dependencies; image OCR also requires system Tesseract. The TXT demo requires neither OCR nor model weights.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/clinrec.git
cd clinrec
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 输出不是诊断、编码正确性或监管合规的保证，需专业复核。
limitations.en: Output does not guarantee diagnosis, coding accuracy or regulatory compliance and requires professional review.

limitations.zh: 默认本地端点不等于强制网络隔离；应核查实际服务配置与数据流。
limitations.en: A local default endpoint does not enforce network isolation; inspect actual service configuration and data flow.
